capital.evidence_quote: Caracas is the federal capital and largest metropolitan center of Venezuela

currency.evidence_quote: The Venezuelan Bolívar Digital/Soberano (VES, Bs) is the official currency; USD cash is widely used

sources.title: Instituto Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología (INAMEH)

timezone.evidence_quote: Venezuela operates on Venezuelan Standard Time UTC-4 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Venezuela is 120V 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: National alternating electrical grid operates at 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: North American standard Type A and Type B two-pin and three-pin sockets are universal

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for unified police and emergency response across Venezuela

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 911 or Cruz Roja Venezolana +58 212 571-4850 for emergency medical dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for fire and rescue emergency operations

general.evidence_quote: VEN 911 is the central emergency operations system in Venezuela

sources.title: Ministerio del Poder Popular para el Turismo (MINTUR)

tourist_police.evidence_quote: MINTUR coordinates tourist security at airports and Canaima National Park via 911

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Suç oranları, siyasi belirsizlik ve ekonomik koşullar nedeniyle Batılı ülkeler Venezuela'ya seyahat uyarısı uygulamaktadır; Türkiye ile doğrudan THY uçuşları bulunmaktadır.
advisory_headline.en: Do Not Travel warning due to crime, civil unrest, and detention risks; Turkish citizens enter visa-free with direct flights via IST.
advisory_headline.de: Reisewarnung: Erhebliche Sicherheitsrisiken, Kriminalität und Versorgungsengpässe.
advisory_headline.ru: Действуют строгие рекомендации воздержаться от поездок; регулярные прямые рейсы связывают Москву и Каракас.
advisory_headline.es: Advertencia de No Viajar de cancillerías occidentales por criminalidad y situación económica; vuelos directos operativos vía Caracas.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Venezuela reach approximately 16.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in urban areas measure 28.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Movistar and Digitel provide 4G SIMs in Caracas. Foreign credit/debit cards often encounter payment rejections; travelers must bring pristine, unmarked US Dollar cash banknotes ($1, $5, $10, $20, $50, $100).
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Foreign payment card processing remains limited; cash US dollars circulate widely as medium of payment

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (approx. 71%) and Protestantism (approx. 17%) with syncretic Maria Lionza devotion
religion.evidence_quote: Catholic traditions coexist alongside the indigenous and spiritist cult of María Lionza in Sorte mountain

festivals.value: Diablos Danzantes de Yare (Dancing Devils of Corpus Christi - UNESCO), Feria de la Chinita in Maracaibo, El Callao Carnival (UNESCO)
festivals.evidence_quote: The Dancing Devils of Corpus Christi perform dramatic devotional dances in colorful horned masks

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Avoid street hailing unofficial taxis; use Ridery or hotel dispatch. Never photograph military installations, presidential sites, or fuel queues. Bring clean, crisp US dollar cash as damaged bills are universally rejected by merchants. Canaima trips require chartered flights.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Merchants routinely refuse torn, marked, or worn US dollar banknotes across commercial transactions

tipping.value: A 10% service charge is usually added to restaurant bills; leaving an extra 5-10% in cash USD is standard and greatly appreciated by staff.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% tip is standard in restaurants and hospitality services
